newsitem.title: USA: Rainforest Cafe Q4 revenues, net soar.
newsitem.headline: Rainforest Cafe Q4 revenues, net soar.

text.p: Rainforest Cafe Inc said Thursday revenues at its restaurant at Walt Disney World in Orlando, Fla., contributed significantly to a strong increase in revenues in the fourth quarter ended December 29.

The restaurant development company said the Disney World restaurant, which opened in July, contributed $7.8 million toward its $20.2 million in revenues in the period. Revenues in the fourth quarter of 1995 totaled $5.8 million, the company said.
Rainforest Cafe said fourth quarter net income reached $2.6 million, up from $632,000 one year ago.
Its shares were trading up 1/4 Thursday at 22-3/8.
